summary: Add free-form tagging to alerts: new Tag entity with many-to-many to Alert, add/remove tag endpoints, optional tag filter on list, tags in AlertResponse.

acceptance_criteria.text: A new Tag concept exists with a many-to-many relationship to Alert, backed by a new join table and an EF Core migration.
POST /api/alerts/{id}/tags adds one or more tags to the alert and returns the updated alert; returns 404 when the alert does not exist.
Adding tags dedupes case-insensitively so an alert never has two tags that differ only by case, and re-adding an existing tag is a no-op.
Adding tags enforces a maximum of 10 tags per alert; a request that would exceed 10 is rejected with a validation error (400).
Each tag value must be 1–30 characters; tags outside that length are rejected with a validation error (400).
DELETE /api/alerts/{id}/tags/{tag} removes the tag assignment from the alert and returns success (204).
DELETE /api/alerts/{id}/tags/{tag} returns 404 when the alert does not exist or the tag is not assigned to that alert.
GET /api/alerts accepts an optional tag query parameter that filters alerts to those carrying the tag, composable with existing isActive, severity, date-range, and search filters.

exact_source_files: AlertService.Data.SQL/Migrations/ (new AddAlertTags migration, generated via dotnet ef)
adjacent_dependencies: database/02_AlertServiceDb_Migrations.sql (idempotent script to keep in sync with the new migration)
constraints: Preserve the layering: controller does HTTP only, service returns DTOs, repository is the only EF Core boundary; service must not reference EF Core.

Match existing conventions: manual entity/DTO mapping in AlertMappingExtensions, DataAnnotations + IValidatableObject validation, constants in AlertConstants, explicit IEntityTypeConfiguration per entity.
Tag length (1-30) and max-tags-per-alert (10) must be expressed as reusable constants in AlertConstants, not magic numbers.
New migration must be generated with the pinned dotnet-ef 8.0.31 tool; keep database/02_AlertServiceDb_Migrations.sql consistent with it.
Validate all tag input at the API boundary (count, length, non-whitespace) and avoid injection via parameterized EF queries only.
coverage_goals: Behavior coverage for each acceptance criterion: add/dedupe/limit/length, delete + 404 paths, tag filter composition, and tags in AlertResponse.
unresolved_questions: Tag storage/normalization: store a single canonical form (recommend trim + preserve original case for display, dedupe/compare case-insensitively) vs. store lowercased. Recommended default: trim, dedupe and match case-insensitively, preserve first-seen casing for display.
Tag sharing model: a global Tag table shared across alerts (recommended, matches 'many-to-many') vs. tags scoped per alert. Recommended default: global Tag table with an AlertTag join entity.
POST response: return full updated AlertResponse (recommended, satisfies AC9 echo) vs. only the tag list. Recommended default: 200 OK with updated AlertResponse (or 404 if alert missing).
tag query filter and DELETE route tag matching case sensitivity. Recommended default: case-insensitive match to stay consistent with dedupe rule.
